listing.name: Final Fantasy Tactics Advance (FFTARecomp)
listing.summary: Register an already prepared FFTARecomp Windows player using your own supported USA or Europe ROM and retained external saves.

steps.title: Complete supported preparation upstream
steps.instruction: Use a complete FFTARecomp copy and components you are permitted to use. Complete the official upstream Installer.exe preparation in a writable folder first; select the resulting installed FFTARecomp.exe, not Installer.exe or the payload template. The v3.0 package carries both FFTARecomp.exe and recomp.exe. Keep them, gamedb.sqlite, TinyCC/compiler support and their applicable notices together. Upstream owns setup, native translation/cache generation and replacement; Portcove does not run the installer or build the game.

steps.title: Keep the exact owned original
steps.instruction: Use your own supported original FFTA USA ROM (SHA-256 43fc8204c6dceee58828aebc7af0c72eb807e99f35ad641c8bb0a4fa8b6edc19) or Europe ROM (8fab1e390cb9d5e695bfdb86e81246892e1aa8c0cb4014db8235ff76538ea632). v3 source supports both, despite older USA-only README wording. No BIOS is needed. The installer can warn and install an unverified image without FFTA patches; that is not this guide’s verified-original route, and success is not proof of exact source identity.

steps.title: Attach the supported prepared player
steps.instruction: Select the completed installed FFTARecomp.exe with its installed directory as working directory and no arguments. This supported wrapper finds its adjacent ffta.gba or the LocalAppData/FFTARecomp fallback, runs its matching recomp.exe play and waits for that initial process through command.output(). Keep the exact prepared tree and private generated translations.

steps.title: Keep optional successor sessions separate
steps.instruction: The optional in-game Switch ROM operation deliberately starts a successor process and ends the current game. The attached wrapper does not wait for that successor after its initial child ends. Treat switching as upstream activity outside this attached session: close every actual player before replacement or another attachment. Do not infer successor tracking, adoption or termination from the registration’s status. Keep the feature intact; no argument or private entry is used to disable or bypass it.

steps.title: Review Play and retain external ownership
steps.instruction: Review and consent to the exact selected executable, established working directory and literal arguments, then choose Play separately. Removing registration preserves external files. Upstream and you retain one runtime-replacement owner; Portcove provides no external update, backup, rollback, migration or deletion. Close actual players and companions before deliberate maintenance, keep the old working copy and all effective data, then review/relink changed selected bytes.

steps.title: Preserve the whole copy and effective data
steps.instruction: Preserve the installed tree and originals, %LOCALAPPDATA%/FFTARecomp data and shared-save-path.txt, %APPDATA%/FFTARecomp/input.cfg and av.cfg, and every effective custom root. Saves resolve FFTA_SAVE_PATH first, then a remembered existing save, then the ROM basename .sav; one neighboring .sav may be chosen and several open a picker. Normal gameplay writes the chosen save. Keep old saves and creating runtime: upstream cross-region compatibility claims and a shared path are not Portcove save qualification. Preserve caches/FFTARecomp translated libraries, mods, logs and backups; upstream may sweep superseded translation-revision caches. MIT project code, MIT/Apache foundation, CC0 gamedb, TinyCC LGPL and font/dependency notices apply separately; code grants do not grant ROM or third-party artwork rights.

warnings: Use only a copy and components you are independently permitted to use. No acquired-source-to-binary, gameplay, real-save, installed-client, Supported or protected acceptance is established. Preserve every original, runtime, save, setting, mod, cache, backup and custom root; another executable can share data.
